name: All Leads Last 30 Days
query:
SELECT u.full_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Qualified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as qualified,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Assigned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as assigned,
       l.custom_created_date AS "Created Date"
FROM `tabLead` l
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON l.lead_owner = u.email
WHERE 
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), l.custom_created_date) <= 30
    AND u.enabled = 1
GROUP BY 
    lead_owner
HAVING qualified + assigned > 0;
